def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    investments = [500, 600, 1000]
    returns = [0.12, 0.05, 0.01]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    total_investment = sum(investments)
    total_return = sum(investment * rate for investment, rate in zip(investments, returns))
    holding_period_return = (total_return / total_investment) * 100

    # return answer
    return round(holding_period_return, 3)
